from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyMonetaryFund(BaseModel):
    """Monetary funds information extracted from one company's financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the document")
    monetary_funds_amount: float | None = Field(description="The monetary funds amount in Yuan")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., 2024 Q1")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label for monetary funds as written in the report, e.g., '货币资金'")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short excerpt from the report containing the monetary funds amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_monetary_funds: list[CompanyMonetaryFund]
